title: Do NOT eat this cake! 🍰🤫
body:
It looks like dessert. It's NOT dessert. 

You know that heavy feeling? The 3 PM office slump. Unread emails are piling up, a Friday deadline is breathing down your neck, and you have that overwhelming urge to just scream into your keyboard. 

Instead, you grab this little slice of pastel dopamine. Volume up. Hear that crisp, satisfying crinkle of the packaging? Now, press your thumbs deeply into the strawberry "frosting." It doesn't just snap back—it slowly inhales, rising like warm, breathing dough against your palms. The thick, marshmallow-like resistance physically melts the nervous tension right out of your rigid fingertips. 

If you're a desk aesthetic lover, a soft-life seeker, or just someone trying to survive daily chaos, this is your secret weapon. 

Every style feels delightfully different—some are dense, some are incredibly airy. Try your luck. 

Breathe in, squeeze deep, let it go. There. The stress is gone. 

Which flavor would you squeeze to save your afternoon? Comment your fav!
